summary.text: Scott Slaugh is a Republican who represents District 64 (Larimer and Weld counties) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where he took office on September 23, 2025, according to Ballotpedia, which lists him as running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia says Slaugh was born in Colorado, began serving in the U.S. Army Reserve in 2003, graduated from Roosevelt High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 2005.
It lists his career experience as business owner and general contractor.
